# An ordinary transaction that imports cleanly, followed by an invoice that is
# refused — here for naming a tax table the book does not hold.
#
# The two are in one file, and `--include-business-objects` saves the book once
# at the end, so the refusal takes the transaction with it. What this fixture
# is for is that the loss is a stated behaviour rather than an accident nobody
# looked at.
2026-06-05 * "Stationery"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Expenses:Supplies 25.00 CAD
	Assets:Bank -25.00 CAD

customer "C-LATE"
	name: "Late Customer"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-LATE"
	customer_id: "C-LATE"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-06-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-06-01
		description: "Service"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: true
		tax_included: false
		tax_table: "A Table This Book Has Never Heard Of"
	posted:
		date: 2026-06-02
		due: 2026-07-01
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "INV-LATE"
		accumulate: true
